method: Filter fresh scalar candidates to bounded one/two-byte spans outside the completed WO65090 address window. Independently hash target ROM bytes; compare spans against all 291 WO70031 target-candidate extents and other selected scalar spans; cross-check exact storageaddress in current Release 1, full definition, tiered XML and Findings markdown.
candidate_decision: 72 rows meet target-byte type/width/count/extent/hash and no table/scalar extent overlap and are absent from the checked definition files; propose only as generic RAW/PROVISIONAL review candidates.
Two exact-address existing definitions are not proposed for duplicate additions: 0x0EDD8 Release 1 curve and 0x1170A full-definition query axis/FND-000017 reference.
Adjacent raw candidate rows are individually backed but adjacency clusters are review aids only; no composite parent structures are asserted.
This is a data-only review ledger, not an XML export: current exporter does not emit scalar_candidates into preview XML and work order does not authorize tool source changes.
No semantic interpretation, runtime function, unit, scaling conversion or calibration name is inferred.
